description: Policy rates of the Fed, ECB, BoE, BoJ, Bank of Canada, RBA, SNB and PBoC: current rate, last change, moves in the past 12 months and the rate path since a date; plus the FOMC dot-plot medians (latest and previous release) when the Fed is included. Official data (BIS, ECB, Federal Reserve). Market-implied rate odds are not included.

banks.description: Central banks by code or short name: fed, ecb, boe, boj, boc, rba, snb, pboc (meetings also cover Riksbank, Norges Bank, RBNZ, RBI). Omit for all.

dot_plot.description: Include the Fed dot plot (default: when the Fed is included).

since.description: Rate path start YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 5 years ago.
